name: Exchange rates
tagline: Today's and past exchange rates for 300 currencies, conversions and rate alerts.
summary: Exchange rates with no sign-in: the European Central Bank's reference rates for 30 major currencies back to 1999, and daily rates for over 300 more, crypto included; conversions, history and charts, and alerts when a rate crosses a level.
can: Convert any amount, at today's rate or on a past date
Show how a rate moved over weeks or years, as a chart
Tell you when a rate goes above or below a level you choose
